alibabacloud-waf-openapi-error-diagnosis v0.0.1

- Initial release for diagnosing Alibaba Cloud WAF OpenAPI parameter errors.
- Supports both WAF 2.0 (2019-09-10) and WAF 3.0 (2021-10-01) API versions across CLI, SDK, and raw RPC.
- Fetches and diffs parameter specs live from official OpenAPI metadata; never performs write actions.
- Only diagnoses parameter-related errors (InvalidParameter, MissingParameter, invalid/malformed parameters, or wrong API version).
- Explicitly identifies the incorrect parameter and provides a corrected call in the same API channel and version.
- Out of scope for credential, permission, throttling, unpurchased feature, 5xx, or rule-effectiveness errors.
